claim.title: Torus Cell pattern self-holding test (N=33 Cayley {1,10,15}, Source parameters)
claim.hypothesis: With only the Node-33 anchor heartbeat, a sealed cell (Buga attenuation + ouroboros trace + spark gap + recycling) holds a planted phase pattern longer than both the Atlantis baseline and a no-cell twin.

metadata.preprocessing: none: raw simulated phases; fidelity = centred complex correlation with the planted seed, 67-tick moving mean
metadata.physical_residual: simulation only (no physical measurement); a 33-oscillator Sakaguchi-Kuramoto toy model

measurement_independence.chi_source: ring phase window theta(t), 33 phases x 64 ticks (one measurement stream)
measurement_independence.omega_source: ring phase window theta(t), 33 phases x 64 ticks (one measurement stream)
measurement_independence.delta_source: ring phase window theta(t), 33 phases x 64 ticks (one measurement stream)
measurement_independence.note: chi=(erank/N)R^2 and delta=1-l1/sum(l) share the covariance eigenspectrum; omega=mean R and R^2 is inside chi. Not independent.

metadata.basis_standardization: phases as raw radians; Psi window 64 ticks every 100 ticks; Omega_0=0.5 (app) or mean R (harness)

recovering_coordinate_search.description: sweep Pi x sigma_ext x K-scale (72 points, seeds 1-2): 14 points fail the per-seed criterion; failures concentrate at K-scale 2 (stronger coupling re-synchronises the ring, survival ~370-1360 ticks < 1429.5 needed)

negative_control.detail: arm C (Pi=1, no cell) survived past 1.5x Atlantis in 0/8 seeds

testable_predictions: A outlasts 1.5 x max(Atlantis, no-cell twin) in >=7/8 seeds
metadata.mathematical_form: dtheta_i = dt[omega_i + K(R)/deg sum sin(theta_j-theta_i-alpha) + u_i] + sqrt(dt)(Pi sigma_ext xi + sigma_inj eta); u_i = spark-gap trace feedback
